stories.headline: Timestral: Mistral release time-series foundation models
stories.summary: Research Introducing Timestral October 15, 2026 By Mistral Back to Blog 7 min read Share this post Copy url to clipboard Copied Thinking Summary Timestral, Mistral’s first family of time-series foundation models, delivers state-of-the-art probabilistic, multivariate forecasts with just 209M parameters, outperforming larger models on key benchmarks while supporting past and future covariates.  Available in four sizes (5M to 209M parameters), it balances accuracy and efficiency, running efficiently on CPUs and excelling in zero-shot forecasting for diverse domains.
